texts: bad: as phrased the question cannot be asked. A count can only be hung on a group that *does* something, so "how many Keepers are active" — a count plus a plain adjective — has no form; "in the present generation" then has nothing to attach to either, so the count and the period cannot be asked together; and the current parse invents a generation whose members are Keepers, which your question never says. Rewrite with a finite verb naming what an active Keeper does, so the count and the period both ride one event: "How many Keepers serve in the present generation?"
